objective: Replace one-shot sci-fi drone sounds with a layered premium industrial drone audio system.

layers.target: dry micro mechanical ceramic/metal actuator, expensive camera-gimbal precision
compact low-mid impulse with controlled pressure, no explosion or gun body
short focused air displacement, not a generic whoosh
very subtle high-detail electronic/metallic decay, non-tonal and non-piercing
small BLDC/gimbal correction texture, never toy quadcopter
clean magnetic/ceramic accent, wider and denser but not louder

premium.feel: expensive aerospace/industrial instrumentation; denser detail, cleaner transient, slightly deeper body

hunter.feel: three coordinated micro-drones; three offset pulses as one designed gesture, not machine-gun fire

events.release: layered transient; main repeated attack sound
events.lock: short servo + magnetic confirmation before/at target acquisition, rate-limited
events.launch: magnetic unlock + BLDC rise + rotor stabilization + air lift
events.dock: motor decay + alignment servo + magnetic seat + satisfying latch
events.targetControlled: short restrained acknowledgement; not a coin/reward chime

mix.note: Values are starting mix offsets, not loudness guarantees. Final tune by device listening.

application.strategy: Producer-authored MIX_NORMAL and MIX_PREMIUM are primary releases; Hunter A/B gestures alternate; Launch/Dock use authored masters; stems retained for later mix tuning.
application.fallback: procedural equipment sound only if V3 release loading fails
